name: workbuddy-dev-team
description: A team of specialized agents that turns a one-sentence requirement into a shipped, verified feature through a spec-driven pipeline.

displayDescription.en: Turns one sentence into a shipped feature: clarify scope, write specs, wait for your approval, implement task by task, run build and tests, then archive.
displayDescription.zh: 把一句话需求推进到可交付：澄清范围、写出规格、等你批准、分任务实现、跑构建与测试、归档沉淀。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Build a feature with me: I'll describe it in one sentence, you handle the rest.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一个功能，我只说一句话，你负责把规格、代码、测试、归档都走完。

quickPrompts.en: Build a feature with me: I'll describe it in one sentence, you handle the rest.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个功能，我只说一句话，你负责把规格、代码、测试、归档都走完。

quickPrompts.en: Add a user login flow to this project, with specs and tests.
quickPrompts.zh: 给这个项目加一套用户登录，要有规格和测试。

quickPrompts.en: Continue the change I paused halfway, don't redo finished tasks.
quickPrompts.zh: 接着做我上次做到一半的需求，别重做已经完成的。
